episodes.title: Death by Misadventure
episodes.summary: When teen Jake Wheeler buys a vintage doll at a yard sale, his young life changes forever.

episodes.title: Give Me Something Good to Eat
episodes.summary: Chucky targets one of Jake's frenemies, forcing Jake to either stop the killer doll -- or help him.

episodes.title: I Like to Be Hugged
episodes.summary: Chucky reminisces about his first murder, urging Jake to make a choice of killing or being killed.

episodes.title: Just Let Go
episodes.summary: Jake's bond with Devon intensifies as he teams up with an unlikely ally to outwit Chucky.

episodes.title: Little Little Lies
episodes.summary: Jake and Devon progress their relationship. Enemies and allies from Chucky's past show up.

episodes.title: Cape Queer
episodes.summary: Jake and his friends set a risky trap for Chucky that could have dire consequences if it backfires.

episodes.title: Twice the Grieving, Double the Loss
episodes.summary: The kids desperately try to figure out Chucky's mysterious endgame before it's too late.

episodes.title: An Affair to Dismember
episodes.summary: Scores will be settled as Chucky's diabolical plan comes to fruition at a dangerous, public venue.

episodes.title: Halloween II
episodes.summary: A year after seemingly defeating their nemesis Chucky, "3 Amigos" Jake, Devon, and Lexy begin receiving mysterious, threatening calls from an all-too-familiar-sounding enemy.

episodes.title: The Sinners Are Much More Fun
episodes.summary: Our 3 Amigos struggle with the strict rules and institutionalized homophobia of their new Catholic reform school, especially when Chucky arrives with a murderous agenda. Meanwhile, in Beverly Hills, a suspicious detective threatens Tiffany's imposture as "Jennifer Tilly" and the discovery of her secret hostage, Nica Pierce.

episodes.title: Hail, Mary!
episodes.summary: With Jake and Devon's relationship already under strain, the reveal that multiple killer dolls exist causes Jake to propose the unthinkable: brainwash the captured Chucky and turn him into an ally.

episodes.title: Death on Denial
episodes.summary: Tiffany's secrets are threatened by the return from college of her 18-year-old kids Glen and Glenda, and by a surprise intervention conducted by several of Jennifer Tilly's loved ones, who are concerned about their old friend's odd behavior.

episodes.title: Doll on Doll
episodes.summary: Devon worries that Good Chucky can't be trusted. Tiffany spirals from the surprise party.

episodes.title: He Is Risen Indeed
episodes.summary: Incarnate Lord goes on lockdown with the Chucky dolls inside. Nica moves forward with her plan.

episodes.title: Goin' to the Chapel
episodes.summary: Ade due Damballa! The survivors band together with Father Bryce to perform an exorcism.

episodes.title: Chucky Actually
episodes.summary: Back in Hackensack for the holidays, the 3 Amigos receive a special gift. Tiffany plots her escape.

episodes.title: Murder at 1600
episodes.summary: Chucky finds a new friend 'til the end in the White House. Jake, Devon and Lexy look for Caroline.

episodes.title: Let the Right One In
episodes.summary: Jake, Devon and Lexy hatch a plan to take down Chucky by befriending the President's teenage son.

episodes.title: Jennifer's Body
episodes.summary: Chucky's complex motivations are revealed. Tiffany is tried for Jennifer Tilly's murder spree.

episodes.title: Dressed to Kill
episodes.summary: Jake, Devon and Lexy infiltrate a Halloween ball to stop Chucky, but the demon doll has other plans.

episodes.title: Death Becomes Her
episodes.summary: Chucky wrestles with his mortality, while Jake and Devon take their romance to the next level.

episodes.title: Panic Room
episodes.summary: Armed with new weapons, Chucky aims to become the most prolific serial killer in history.

episodes.title: There Will Be Blood
episodes.summary: Parapsychologists investigate the disturbances in the White House, while Tiffany plans her escape.

episodes.title: Final Destination
episodes.summary: Jake faces his demons and a new type of evil in the quest to find Caroline.
